title: Growing a Tree Through the Clutter: RRT and RRT-Connect for an Arm, Why Two Trees Beat One, and the Planner That Must Know When to Give Up

questions.question: Why can a planner for an arm not use a grid?
options: Six dimensions are too many cells, and the obstacles are not simple in joint space: the only way to know is to ask the collision model
questions.explanation: A million cells at ten steps a side.

questions.question: Across 6 seeds, how many did RRT-Connect and RRT find?
How long were the paths against the straight line in joint space?
With the goal inside the wall the planner:
options: Said so at once: no path, 0 iterations
Found a path through the wall
questions.explanation: A goal that fails the pose check.

questions.question: Why does a second tree from the goal help so much?
options: Each tree reaches out and they meet, where one tree has to hit a small goal in a large space

questions.question: What does the goal bias do?
options: Samples the goal one time in ten to pull the tree towards it
